reason: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with Paseo as an ACP provider, enabling users to launch, run, monitor, and stop multiple dsh agents from Paseo clients.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 集成为 Paseo 的 ACP provider，支持从 Paseo 客户端启动、管理和并行运行多个 dsh agent。
summaries.en: Integrates DeepSeek Harness as a Paseo ACP provider for launching, managing, and running multiple dsh agents in parallel from Paseo clients.

capabilities: Registers a DSH ACP provider in Paseo
Spawns and manages independent dsh agent processes
Runs agent tasks with workspace file and shell access
Transmits prompts and agent activity through ACP over stdio
Uses dsh-configured model endpoints and credentials
